name: What are the differences between a penthouse in a high-rise building versus a top-floor unit?

mainEntity.name: What are the differences between a penthouse in a high-rise building versus a top-floor unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: While both offer elevated views, a true penthouse is typically the most exclusive unit on the highest floor, often encompassing a larger footprint or even multiple levels with unique architectural features not found in standard top-floor units. Penthouses frequently include private terraces, larger balconies, and direct elevator access. Top-floor units, while high up, may have a similar layout to other units on lower floors without these distinguishing luxury elements. The specific floor plan, amenities, and design are key decision factors when comparing options.
acceptedAnswer.description: A penthouse is typically a larger, more exclusive top-floor unit with unique features like private terraces, while a top-floor unit may just be a standard unit on the highest floor.
